sections.heading: Restore exercise
paragraphs: On 2026-09-18, the operations lead restored production tenant Cobalt-17 from an encrypted daily snapshot to the isolated recovery account. RTO 45 minutes against 60-minute target; checksum 8a42 matched the source manifest. Security and the customer success lead signed the test on 2026-09-19.

sections.heading: Project gate
paragraphs: Project Beacon went live on 2026-07-12. Its security review ticket is marked deferred until 2026-11-15, although project policy requires review before production launch.

sections.heading: Asset returns
paragraphs: The CMDB reconciled 254 staff laptops, 14 AWS accounts, 83 code repositories and six SaaS vendors on 2026-09-30. Seven departing staff returned assigned laptops in September. The eighth, departure 2026-09-26, remains pending in the asset-return queue.

sections.heading: Access exception
paragraphs: The JIT production-admin grant to Devika Rao on 2026-09-21 expired after 60 minutes and the SIEM retained the approval event.
